In 2019, NPPES and PECOS contained 8,455 and 5,897 nurse-midwife records, respectively, within the declared study frame. Among records present with the field available in each source, practice location ZIP codes (including group reassignments) were populated in 100.0% and 95.7%, respectively. Among 5,570 comparable nurse-midwives, at least one value matched in 77.4%, whereas the complete reported value sets agreed in 7.1%. Enrollment linkage identified 29 direct and 184,694 group-reassignment nurse-midwife-enrollment-location associations; these administrative associations did not establish clinical presence. Cross-source disagreement was not classified as verified inaccuracy.

In 2026, NPPES and DAC contained 12,170 and 5,877 nurse-midwife records, respectively, within the declared study frame. Among records present with the field available in each source, practice location ZIP codes were populated in 99.9% and 100.0%, respectively. Among 5,877 comparable nurse-midwives, at least one value matched in 53.6%, whereas the complete reported value sets agreed in 39.3%. In deterministic administrative registry linkage across 3,190 audited nurse-midwives, 1,938 yielded a complete registry disposition (1 partial, 1,251 unresolved/unmatched; weighted registry disposition rate 60.8% after excluding 0 confirmed-ineligible records; file-based registry matching does not constitute a respondent survey). Cross-source disagreement was not classified as verified inaccuracy.
